items.title: OpenAI limits GPT-5.6 rollout after government request, says restrictions shouldn't be the norm
items.title_zh: OpenAI 应政府要求限制 GPT-5.6 发布，称限制不应成为常态
items.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5.6, its next-generation model two months after GPT-5.5, but with a limited rollout after the U.S. government requested user vetting. OpenAI stated it doesn't believe this kind of government access process should become the long-term default, noting it 'keeps the best tools from users, developers, enterprises, cyber defenders, and global partners who need them.'

items.title: Anthropic cleared to release Claude Mythos 5 to over 100 US institutions
items.title_zh: Anthropic 获准向 100 余家美国机构发布 Claude Mythos 5
items.summary: Following an export control directive two weeks ago that forced Anthropic to disable access to Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5, the Trump administration has cleared Mythos 5 for release to over 100 U.S. companies and government agencies, including their non-American employees. The move follows negotiations with the administration.

items.title: DeepSeek Transforms From Idealism to Aggressive Expansion with $7B Funding and Massive Hiring
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 从理想主义转向激进扩张：获 70 亿美元融资并大规模招聘
items.summary: DeepSeek pivots from its 'no funding, no commercialization' stance with a record $7 billion funding round, plans to double all departments, and launches its first commercial products. The Chinese AI lab is shifting from an idealistic research model to aggressive commercial expansion.

items.title: Apple asks Trump admin to approve Chinese RAM after product price increases
items.title_zh: 苹果向特朗普政府申请批准采购中国内存芯片，此前产品全线涨价
items.summary: Apple is seeking clearance from the Trump administration to purchase memory chips from blacklisted Chinese company CXMT (长鑫存储), after rising memory chip costs forced Apple to raise prices on Macs and iPads during Amazon Prime Day. The Financial Times reports six sources confirmed the lobbying effort.

items.title: UBTECH Sells 5,000 Companion Robots in Two Weeks, Eyes Consumer Market Breakthrough
items.title_zh: 优必选伴侣机器人两周售出 5000 台，瞄准消费市场突破
items.summary: UBTECH's U1 full-size humanoid companion robot recorded over 5,000 pre-orders in under three weeks, signaling growing consumer appetite for emotional AI robots. The humanoid robot is designed as a social companion rather than an industrial tool.

items.title: 智元旗下灵巧手估值10亿美元，成立仅5个月首季实现盈利
items.title_zh: 智元旗下灵巧手估值10亿美元，成立仅5个月首季实现盈利
items.summary: 智元机器人旗下的灵巧手业务独立运营仅5个月后估值达到10亿美元，并在首季度实现盈利。该灵巧手专注于具身智能机器人末端执行器的研发和商业化。与此同时，DeepSeek 计划将所有部门规模扩大至少一倍。

items.title: VW could cut 100,000 jobs and close 4 factories in a radical shake-up
items.title_zh: 大众汽车或裁员 10 万人并关闭 4 家工厂进行激进重组
items.summary: Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume is reportedly preparing the most dramatic overhaul in the automaker's history, with plans that could eliminate up to 100,000 jobs and close four factories amid falling sales in the U.S. and especially China.

items.title: It's not about Anthropic vs. OpenAI anymore
items.title_zh: AI 竞争已不再是 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 之间的对决
items.summary: AI models have progressed to the point where their capabilities have real political consequences. TechCrunch argues that dealing with those consequences will require collective action from the industry, moving beyond company rivalries.

items.title: Why everyone from OpenAI to SpaceX is building their own chips (and turning up the heat on Nvidia)
items.title_zh: 从 OpenAI 到 SpaceX，为何各大公司纷纷自研芯片，对英伟达形成压力
items.summary: Nvidia has dominated the AI chip market for years, but the era of total dependence may be ending as OpenAI shared plans to develop its own chips, joining a growing list of companies including SpaceX that are building custom silicon to reduce reliance on Nvidia.

items.title: FTC gives Musk the OK to acquire SpaceX alumni startup Mesh
items.title_zh: FTC 批准马斯克收购前 SpaceX 工程师创立的光模块初创公司 Mesh
items.summary: The FTC approved Elon Musk's acquisition of Mesh Optical Technologies Corporation, founded by three former SpaceX engineers. Mesh came out of stealth in February with a $50 million Series A and specializes in optical interconnect technology.

items.title: Gemini's new Google Play Store integration lets you chat to find Android apps, games
items.title_zh: Gemini 集成 Google Play Store，支持对话式搜索 Android 应用与游戏
items.summary: As previewed at I/O 2026, the Gemini app on Android now integrates with the Google Play Store, allowing users to find apps and games through natural conversation. Google is also rolling out Gemini to existing Android Automotive vehicles.

items.title: OpenAI poaches Uber India chief to lead its biggest market outside the US
items.title_zh: OpenAI 挖角 Uber 印度负责人，领导其美国以外最大市场
items.summary: OpenAI hired Uber's India chief to lead its biggest market outside the U.S., marking its latest push into India with expanding offices, partnerships, and hiring efforts.

items.title: Tesla settles FSD crash lawsuit as federal investigations continue
items.title_zh: 特斯拉就 FSD 致命事故诉讼达成和解，联邦调查仍在继续
items.summary: Tesla settled a lawsuit connected to a fatal 2023 crash involving a vehicle using its Full Self-Driving (FSD) advanced driver assistance system. Federal investigations into Tesla's FSD system remain ongoing.

items.title: Robotaxis drive miles just to get cleaned and charged; this new startup wants to fix that
items.title_zh: Robotaxi 空驶数英里仅为清洁充电，新创业公司试图解决这一痛点
items.summary: Aseon Labs, a Y Combinator 2026 spring cohort company, raised $10 million from Crane Venture Partners and others to build dedicated pit stops for cleaning and charging robotaxis, addressing a key infrastructure gap in the autonomous ride-hailing ecosystem.

items.title: South Korea plans to train entire military as 'drone warriors'
items.title_zh: 韩国计划将全部军队训练为无人机战士
items.summary: South Korea announced plans to train its entire half-million-strong military on drone operation as a 'universal combat tool,' reflecting the growing role of autonomous and semi-autonomous systems in modern defense strategy.

items.title: NYT slams Microsoft for building copyright-infringing supercomputer for OpenAI
items.title_zh: 纽约时报指控微软为 OpenAI 构建用于侵犯版权的超级计算机
items.summary: The New York Times shifted its copyright claims against OpenAI and Microsoft after a Supreme Court ruling against Sony, now alleging that Microsoft built a supercomputer specifically to help OpenAI infringe copyrights. The case represents a significant escalation in the legal battle over AI training data.

items.title: 追赶FSD V14，理想在补哪些课？
items.title_zh: 追赶FSD V14，理想在补哪些课？
items.summary: 文章分析理想汽车在智能驾驶领域追赶特斯拉 FSD V14 的技术路径。行业竞争已从硬件堆料转向端到端、VLA（Vision-Language-Action）和世界模型（World Model）路线，理想正在补足算法和数据方面的短板。

items.title: 具身世界模型'我悟'通过合规备案
items.title_zh: 具身世界模型'我悟'通过合规备案
items.organization: 北京人形机器人创新中心
items.summary: 北京人形机器人创新中心慧思开物平台的双大脑模型天鹕（Pelican-VL）和我悟（WoW）同步完成北京市网信办生成式人工智能服务备案。北京人形将正式启动慧思开物全系列模型 Token 服务，计划分阶段面向产业客户、科研机构和开发者开放 API。

items.title: vivo Launches X Fold6 With Custom AI Chip and OS, Turning Foldable Into an AI Workstation
items.title_zh: vivo 发布 X Fold6：搭载定制 AI 芯片与操作系统，将折叠屏打造为 AI 工作站
items.summary: vivo's X Fold6 features a custom Dimensity 9500 chip and OriginOS 6 Fold with 'Parallel Mode' enabling five simultaneous AI tasks. The foldable phone is positioned as an AI workstation, priced from RMB 7,999.

items.title: MediaTek Emerges as Major Challenger in Optical Interconnect Chip Market
items.title_zh: 联发科进军光互连芯片市场，挑战博通与 Marvell 双头垄断
items.summary: MediaTek enters the optical interconnect chip market with CPO (co-packaged optics) technology and Micro LED optical solutions, challenging the duopoly held by Broadcom and Marvell in high-speed data center interconnects.

items.title: 高通计划将数据中心芯片技术引入智能手机，提升端侧AI能力
items.title_zh: 高通计划将数据中心芯片技术引入智能手机，提升端侧AI能力
items.summary: 高通执行副总裁杜尔加·马拉迪表示，公司计划将本周新发布的数据中心芯片 HBC（高带宽计算）架构应用于智能手机。该架构采用芯片垂直堆叠设计，将内存与计算单元紧密集成，可显著提升数据传输速度，第一代产品将于明年在数据中心推出，预计 2028 年进入手机市场。

items.title: commaai/openpilot
items.title_zh: commaai/openpilot：开源自动驾驶操作系统
items.summary: Openpilot is an open-source operating system for robotics that upgrades the driver assistance system on 300+ supported car models. Written in Python, it provides adaptive cruise control, lane keeping, and driver monitoring.

items.title: opendatalab/MinerU
items.title_zh: opendatalab/MinerU：将复杂文档转换为 LLM 就绪格式
items.summary: MinerU transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office files into LLM-ready markdown and JSON for agentic workflows. The Python-based tool preserves document structure including tables, formulas, and images.

items.title: garrytan/gstack
items.title_zh: garrytan/gstack：Garry Tan 的 Claude Code 多智能体开发工具集
items.summary: gstack is Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup featuring 23 opinionated AI tools acting as CEO, Designer, Engineering Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA. A multi-agent framework for AI-assisted software development.

items.title: OctoSense: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Robot Perception
items.title_zh: OctoSense：面向多模态机器人感知的自监督学习
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, thermal camera, IMU, and RTK-corrected GPS — all synchronized via hardware triggering. The paper introduces a self-supervised learning approach for fusing these multimodal streams for robust robot perception.
